title: Encounter with Moff Gideon
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: In the vile clutches of the evil Moff Gideon in a prison cell aboard Gideon's cruiser, Grogu is held in wrist binders. Moff Gideon threatens him and tells him how important he is, but also the powerlessness of his situation. Grogu lashes out, but it's no good. Moff Gideon has thought of everything, and young Grogu may never see the Mandalorian again!
